parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: Optional tenant UUID; omit to list all owner tickets across tenants (W1 aggregate).

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the current UTC hour window ends

info.title: Ticket API — D4 CS/export/events
info.description: Identity, redemption, gate, CS lookup/resend, CSV export (MinIO), event admin, device tokens. Notification providerStatus ACCEPTED ≠ delivered. PostgreSQL is source of truth.

answers.description: Map fieldId → string|boolean; unknown keys rejected

clientOccurredAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC when the scan was accepted on-device

clientClockAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC client wall clock when the batch was assembled

quotaCapacityState.description: FINITE: capacity number + remaining; UNLIMITED: bucket capacity null; MISSING_BUCKET: no EVENT bucket

rejectByReason.description: Gate rejects by stable reason — no attendee PII

registeredAt.description: ISO timestamp when registration became active

role.description: MembershipRole enum or { presetId } — never client permission arrays

staffEligible.description: true iff active tenant membership OR active event assignment

deliveryState.description: ACCEPTED = outbox processing completed; never proof of inbox delivery
